objective: Test four transition-conditioned alternatives directly against the static multi-sleeve baseline without creating a capital router.

hypotheses.rationale: Highest mean exploratory test-fold excess versus both SPY and static multi-sleeve among transition candidates, with positive excess in 75% of folds versus static.
Industry momentum showed repeated exploratory relative strength during the strongest five-session trend deceleration.
Factor momentum showed positive exploratory excess versus static in 71% of evaluable folds when cross-sectional momentum dispersion was lowest.
Regime multi-sleeve had the highest exploratory consistency versus static in the low momentum-dispersion state, positive in 79% of evaluable folds.
